WHY THE ACQUIRED QC FAMILY DOES NOT GENERATE THE ROC FRONTIER
31 October 2026. A quantitative exact barrier, not a QC obstruction.

Keep F, C0, the completed capacity kernel and the verified QC polynomial
p0=F+C0+4096T, T(A)=|A|^2. The retained globally ROC comparator is
p1=F+C0+1859T. No QC status is inferred for p1.

Theorem. Start with p0 and F, and allow any finite sequence of:

 * positive convex combinations with leading coefficient normalized to F;
 * argument translations and scalar rescaling preserving leading F;
 * output SO(2) and the F-preserving positive Gamma transformation;
 * addition of globally QC quadratic polynomials;
 * affine or determinant gauges and coefficientwise limits.

If this generated cone contains F+C0+nu T, then necessarily

                       nu >= 4095.795157422027...

The exact rational lower bound is 2237 plus the retained scalar ROC
lower witness at (u,xi)=( (1,981203/1000000),
                        (1,-385371/1000000) ).
In particular the globally ROC polynomial p1 lies outside this generated
QC cone. This is not a ROC-versus-QC separation: other QC mechanisms
are entirely unrestricted. The conclusion explains why spanning all
eight cubic charges does not make these operations complete.

1. AN EXACT GROUP-INVARIANT QUOTIENT METRIC

For cubic coefficients c_alpha use the Bombieri tensor norm

               ||C||_B^2=sum_(|alpha|=3)
                           (prod alpha_i!/3!) c_alpha^2.

This is the squared Euclidean norm of the associated symmetric
three-tensor, hence is preserved by orthogonal changes in the four
matrix coordinates. Output rotations and Gamma are orthogonal and
preserve F. Therefore the four-dimensional subspace {DF.h} of
translation cubics is invariant under these transformations.

Take the orthogonal quotient by that translation subspace in this
metric. In the retained eight charge coordinates it has an explicit
rational positive definite Gram matrix M. Let z0 be C0's charge vector
and m0=z0^T M z0>0. Every symmetry image g C0 has the same charge norm.

The exact construction uses the literal twenty monomials, their weights
prod alpha_i!/3!, the translation matrix and the unit charge section.
It orthogonally projects the section off translations, constructs M,
and verifies

            L^T M+M L=0,       Gamma_q^T M Gamma_q=M,

where L is the infinitesimal continuous output-rotation action. T
